definitions.explanation: The standard, default portion size at a restaurant. Particularly used at chain restaurants like beef bowl and ramen shops where multiple sizes are available.

examples.japanese: {並盛|なみも}りでお{願|ねが}いします。
{並盛|なみも}りで{十分|じゅうぶん}お{腹|なか}いっぱいになった。
examples.english: I was fully satisfied with the regular serving.

examples.japanese: {大盛|おおも}りにしようか{迷|まよ}ったけど、{並盛|なみも}りでも{結構|けっこう}{量|りょう}があるから{並|なみ}にした。
examples.english: I was torn about getting a large, but the regular has a decent amount, so I went with that.

notes:
USAGE:
{並盛|なみも}り is the base/default serving size at restaurants offering multiple portion options. Often abbreviated to just {並|なみ} when ordering.

ORDERING:
At a {牛丼|ぎゅうどん} chain, you might say: 「{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}{並|なみ}で」 (beef bowl, regular size).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {並盛|なみも}りで (regular size, please)
- {並盛|なみも}りにする (to go with the regular size)

RELATED WORDS:
- {大盛|おおも}り: large serving
- {特盛|とくも}り: extra-large serving
- {小盛|こも}り: small serving (available at some shops)
